# LIMB 1 required 2+ of 4 resolvable by a non-redirect channel. It FIRES at 2 clean.
# --- THE HAZARD THIS ACTION FOUND, which is worth more than the two resolutions --------------
# A package registry's declared repository URL is a DATED claim: it records the path AT PUBLISH
# TIME, not the canonical path now. Same channel, same field, opposite evidentiary value:
#   INGInious  uploaded 2026-01-23 -> 9 months old  -> probative
#   ease       uploaded 2013-06-07 -> 13 years old  -> names edx/ease, which predates the
#              edx -> openedx organisation rename entirely, so it is evidence about 2013
# STANDING RULE ADDED: never read a registry URL as a canonical pointer without its upload date.
# p225's ACTION SD concluded: "publish as ONE row under openedx/edx-platform with the alias noted".
# The project's own README, served byte-identically from both paths, names openedx-platform 5
# times and edx-platform 0 times. The canonical direction is the OPPOSITE of what p225 published.
# This supersedes p225's recommendation on evidence, and is left standing as the dated record.
# The README's mebis-lp links point at THREE SIBLING REPOSITORIES, not at the AI manager itself.
# That is evidence about the owner's repository SET (p224's own unit for an alias), not a direct
# self-reference. It is recorded as weak because these shelves cite bycs-lp 30 times to mebis-lp's
# 11, and a 3-of-3 sibling signal is not enough to invert a 30-to-11 citation habit on its own.
